_comment: OSM .osm.pbf source extracts per region id (matches tiles/regions.json). Kept separate from regions.json so the display tiles pipeline (build-display.sh) is unaffected and never leaks these into manifest.json. Each DISTINCT source here is downloaded + filtered to highways exactly once (prepare-source.sh; CI fans it out via the prepare job), then build-routing.sh osmium-merges the prefiltered roads for multi-source regions and runs tilemaker clipped to the region's extent bbox. Continent-level Geofabrik extracts are used: a region whose bbox is a sub-area of a continent (me, sas, and every na-*/eu-* chunk) reads the whole continent and lets tilemaker's --bbox clip; cross-continent regions (eas, sea-oc) merge two extracts. Because of the fan-out, the four Asia regions share one asia download, the three na-* one north-america download, the two eu-* one europe download. These are large weekly downloads — see the workflow header for the cost note.
